hero.title: About me
hero.intro: Hi — I’m Erik. I build things: automation, web, Raspberry Pi, tools, and small experiments that are meant to simply work in the end.

mindset.title: How I think
mindset.text: I value clear structures, clean surfaces, and pragmatic solutions. If something is annoying, it gets automated. If something is missing, it gets built.

work.title: What I work on
list: Automation & engineering topics (industry, processes, standards, clean implementation)
Raspberry Pi & home setups (kiosk displays, monitoring, utilities)

tech.title: Tech I like
tech.text: Depending on the project: Siemens / industrial stacks, web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript), Node.js, APIs, Raspberry Pi — and anything that stays robust and maintainable.
